caption: The drawing depicts a formal dress composed primarily of white fabric with red accents and intricate lace details. The bodice is fitted and white, featuring a high collar and a V-shaped red panel bordered by white lace at the front. Red fabric is also visible at the ends of the sleeves. The skirt is full and floor-length, consisting of layered white fabric with lace trim and a draped overskirt that is gathered at the back, creating a bustle effect. The lower portion of the skirt displays alternating patterns of lace and embroidery, with a scalloped hem that reveals an underlayer of bright red fabric. The entire dress is depicted without a wearer, and there are no visible background elements apart from the neutral, off-white background of the drawing.
title: Visiting Dress
